demands.title: Independent probe into the exam leak
demands.text: An independent, time-bound investigation (not run by the same agency implicated) into how the exam paper was leaked, with findings made public.

demands.title: Structural reform of the testing agency
demands.text: A public audit of the exam-conducting body's security, vendor contracts, and IT systems, with a published corrective action plan and independent oversight going forward.

demands.title: Fair re-exam for affected candidates
demands.text: A re-test on a fixed near-term date for every candidate whose exam was compromised, with travel and fee costs covered by the conducting body, not the students.

demands.title: Accountability at the top
demands.text: Named accountability for the officials and ministers responsible for oversight failures, decided through due process rather than announcement.

demands.title: Right to Information disclosure
demands.text: Suo motu publication of the leak investigation's terms of reference, timeline, and interim findings under the Right to Information Act, without requiring individual RTI requests.

demands.title: Protection for whistleblowers and students
demands.text: No disciplinary, academic, or legal action against students or staff who came forward with evidence of the leak or joined peaceful protests about it.

demands.title: Tamper-proof exam process going forward
demands.text: End-to-end digital chain of custody for question papers, with independent audit logs, before the next exam cycle.
